div.div:
/rfe-review
work-item review orchestrator
--type {t} (rfe default)
--headless
--caller split
one or more {IDs}
tools: Bash, Agent, AskUserQuestion

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 248px; height: 1px; padding-top: 84px; margin-left: 303px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Step 0: Resolve Type, Persist
bash scripts/bootstrap.sh --layout
type_registry.py resolve [--type t]
launch-vars {TYPE} review: the {VAR}
block prepended to every agent prompt
state.py init tmp/{STATE_PREFIX}review-config.yaml
state.py write-ids ...review-all-ids.txt

div.div:
Step 1: Fetch Agents
opus, background, one per remote ID
prompts/fetch-agent.md
fetch_issue.py {KEY} --fetch-all
MCP getJiraIssue fallback on exit 2
writes task, original, -comments.md

div.div:
Step 1.5: Setup
two parallel Bash calls
scripts/fetch-architecture-context.sh
{BOOTSTRAP}: the assess-rfe rubric
both failures are non-fatal

Step 2: Per-ID Agent Wave - (1 + dimensions) x N agents in parallel
the orchestrator never reads an item body: only frontmatter.py read and --list-ids

div.div:
Dimension Agents
one per DIMENSIONS entry
rfe: feasibility (blocking)
initiative: feasibility + alignment
(parent_key startswith RHAISTRAT-)

div.div:
Poll the Wave
state.py write-ids {POLL_FILE_PREFIX}
check_review_progress.py --phase ...
sleep the reported NEXT_POLL
blocking dimension PENDING is an
error; non-blocking is a note

frontmatter.py set on the review file
fetch_failed, assess_failed,
{name}_failed, review_failed
score=0 pass=false needs_attention=true
ID dropped from the processing list

python3 scripts/frontmatter.py set
artifacts/rfe-reviews/ID-review.md
rfe_id=ID score=0 pass=false
recommendation=revise
feasibility=feasible
auto_revised=false
needs_attention=true
scores.what=0 scores.why=0

scores.not_a_task=0
scores.right_sized=0
error="fetch_failed: task file
not created"
type=rfe

div.div:
Step 3: Review Agents
opus, background, {FIRST_PASS}=true
prompts/review-agent.md
reads the assess result and every
dimension file, never the item body
body from {SECTIONS_PATH}, verdict
from {RULES_PATH}
writes {REVIEWS_DIR}/{ID}-review.md

div.div:
artifacts/rfe-reviews/ID-review.md
rfe_id: RHAIRFE-1595 # required
score: 10 # int
pass: true # bool
recommendation: submit # submit /
# revise / split / reject /
# autorevise_reject
feasibility: feasible # feasible /
# infeasible / indeterminate
auto_revised: false # bool
needs_attention: false # bool
scores: # required
what: 2
why: 2
open_to_how: 2
not_a_task: 2
right_sized: 2
# optional: local_id, type,
# tracker_ref, error, before_score,
# before_scores

Needs
revision?
state.py read-ids, then
filter_for_revision.py

opus, background
prompts/revise-agent.md
edits only the flagged sections of
{TASKS_DIR}/{ID}.md
check_content_preservation.py
--write-yaml
appends to ## Revision History

check_revised.py --batch {TYPE_FLAG}
--ids-file {POLL_FILE_PREFIX}revise.txt

prints STALE_COMPANIONS= and drops
the empty removed-context files

state.py set-default reassess_cycle=0 - never resets an existing counter,
so re-entry after context compression is safe

preserve_review_state.py save:
ID-review-state.json
rm {REVIEWS_DIR}/{ID}-review.md
rm {ASSESS_STAGING}/{ID}.result.md
state.py write-ids ...reassess-ids.txt

div.div:
4d-4e. Restore, Re-filter
preserve_review_state.py restore:
before_scores, auto_revised, history
filter_for_revision.py: a score
regression sets autorevise_reject
revise again, then check_revised.py
--clear-addressed-attention
